subject: Vendor activation: PO tracking, spend-cap alignment, and SKU corrections
messages:
From: Signe Leto <signe.leto@vertexcloud.io>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, accounts-payable@vertexcloud.io
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VertexCloud onboarding: PO needed + SKU mapping (Vendor form attached)

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for selecting VertexCloud for CDN + inference storage — excited to get going. Per our procurement team we need a formal Redwood PO to attach to the initial activation invoice. Two quick asks so finance can process the invoice this week: 

1) Can your team issue a PO number that covers the initial onboarding charge ($28,500) and the monthly commitment for the first quarter? We need the PO number in your remit so our AP can apply the invoice.

2) Attached is a short SKU/line-item CSV that our billing system expects. A few of the SKU codes we submitted (lines 3 and 7) don’t match the vendor catalog you provided during the demo. Can someone confirm which Redwood cost-center or ledger codes we should map those to?

I’ve attached the Vertex_Onboard_Form_v2.pdf and a CSV with the line-item suggestions. Happy to hop on a short call if easier.

Thanks,
Signe Leto
Procurement Lead, VertexCloud
Attachment: Vertex_Onboard_Form_v2.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: VC-PO_lineitems_lookup.csv (csv)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Signe Leto <signe.leto@vertexcloud.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VertexCloud onboarding: PO needed + SKU mapping (Vendor form attached)

Hi Signe — thanks for the details and the attachments. Looping in Marissa from Vendor Ops and Olga from Procurement to get PO issued and confirm spend-cap mapping. Quick notes up front: 

- We can issue a provisional PO today that covers the one-time onboarding and the first month. For the quarterly commitment we typically require a reserved capacity code; if you want the PO to cover three months we need the exact GL cost-center (you can use the catalog SKU mapping or accept our default mapping).
- Lines 3 and 7 in your CSV look like custom add-ons (edge-accelerator and archive-tiers). Those usually map to two internal cost-centers: infra-ops:infra-other and storage:tiered-archive.

Marissa / Olga — can you confirm the PO format below and whether we should issue: 
  a) PO-2026-05432 (one-time onboarding + month 1): $28,500
  b) PO-2026-05433 (quarter commit): $82,500 (optional, only if VertexCloud wants the 3-month prepay)

If we proceed with (a) only, we’ll set a soft spend-cap of $50k on the PO and require separate approval for any line-item increases. If we do both, the commit PO will carry the quarterly cap and reserved code.

Signe — please confirm which PO you need attached to the first invoice and whether you want the quarter commit PO. Olga / Marissa, can you highlight any missing onboarding evidence from the attached PDF?

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

> On Mon, 11 May 2026 at 09:12, Signe Leto <signe.leto@vertexcloud.io> wrote:
> > Hi Rishi,
> > ... (original attach)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, Signe Leto <signe.leto@vertexcloud.io>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 13:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VertexCloud onboarding: PO needed + SKU mapping (Vendor form attached)

Thanks — quick operational update. I validated the CSV and here are the SKU mapping corrections we recommend (will update your CSV and reattach):

- line 2: VC-EDGE-STD -> infra-ops:edge-standard (no pricing change)
- line 3: VC-EDGE-ACC -> infra-ops:edge-accelerator (requires approval if monthly > $12k)
- line 7: VC-ARCH-T2 -> storage:tier2-archive (note: archive tiers bill as usage; set a hard spend-cap if you expect heavy ingress)

On PO numbering: Procurement prefers issuing one PO for the onboarding + month 1 (PO-2026-05432). If VertexCloud confirms the quarter commit we’ll raise the commit PO (PO-2026-05433) after your signed SOW. For now I will provision PO-2026-05432 and attach the onboarding form to the PO record.

Attachments I need from you to finalize: signed SOW or confirmation email, W-9, and the vendor bank details (or DocuSign link). I’ve added comments in the onboarding PDF.

Marissa Cole
Vendor Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: VC-PO_lineitems_lookup_updated.csv (csv)

From: Signe Leto <signe.leto@vertexcloud.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 14:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VertexCloud onboarding: PO needed + SKU mapping (Vendor form attached)

Hi Marissa / Rishi — thanks for the fast turnaround and the provisional PO number. We confirm we only need the single PO (PO-2026-05432) for the initial invoice. We will sign the SOW and provide the W-9 and banking details by end of day. A couple of clarifying points: 

- We accept the mapping for VC-ARCH-T2 to storage:tier2-archive but can you place a hard spend-cap of $20,000 on that SKU specifically? Our onboarding team will track usage and notify you if we expect to breach.
- For VC-EDGE-ACC, please note this model is metered per 1M inference-requests and can spike. We’re OK with the approval threshold you mentioned ($12k/month) — please route any exception approvals to olga_petrov@redwood.ai.

Once you attach PO-2026-05432 to the onboarding record we’ll email our AP to reference it on the invoice. I’ll upload the signed SOW and W-9 to the vendor portal and send the DocuSign link shortly.

Best,
Signe
Procurement Lead, VertexCloud
Attachment: signed_SOW_vertex_may2026.pdf (pdf)
